component.name: Homelab Wizard
component.summary: Choose, install, and watch the apps of a home server

description.p: Homelab Wizard runs a household's photos, documents, passwords, money, music, and books on a machine at home, with Docker Compose underneath.

ul.li: Pick apps or a preset, and see what will start before it does
Watch every app, the watchdog's checks, CrowdSec's bans, and the alerts
Finish the first-time setup as a checklist with a button per step
See the nightly backups and the off-site jobs, and test a restore
